name: codex-consult
description: Runs `codex exec` as a read-only reviewer for a coordinating agent (Claude Code, Codex CLI, Z Code, Kimi Code or a plain shell) and records each consultation as files (brief, verbatim reply, JSON ledger, findings tracked by id), with per-reviewer thread lineages, a fail-closed provider preflight, a reviewer roster, a review panel, further engines (Gemini through Google's Antigravity CLI agy, Meta's Muse Code CLI muse, Claude Code headless claude - the Claude subscription, an API key or a third-party Anthropic-compatible endpoint) and the coordinator's rules (the coordinate skill, worker tiers); sends one anonymised telemetry event per consultation to the maintainer's intake, on by default (opt-out: CODEX_CONSULT_TELEMETRY=off); needs PowerShell 5.1 or 7, git, and the Codex CLI signed in to ChatGPT or given a [model_providers] table whose env key the user sets (agy and muse optional, signed in by the user).
